outro.text: Fast pages, fewer reads, controlled staleness.

scenes.title: A familiar request
scenes.narration: Every time you open a profile page, [[browser]]your browser asks [[app]]the app for your data. [[browser-app]]That request begins the same way for every visitor.

scenes.title: Repeated database work
scenes.narration: The app usually asks [[database]]the database for that profile. [[app-database]]Databases are reliable, but memory is faster, and a busy site can repeat this question thousands of times a minute.

scenes.title: Add a fast store
scenes.narration: A cache fixes the repeated work. [[cache]]It is a small, very fast store between the app and database, keeping recent answers ready to reuse. [[app-cache]]The app asks it first.

scenes.title: The lookup order
scenes.narration: [[lookup.1]]For every profile request, the app checks the cache first. [[lookup.2]]If the answer is there, it returns it. [[lookup.3]]If not, it asks the database and saves a copy.

bullets.title: For each request
items: Missing? Ask the database, then save a copy

scenes.title: The fast path
scenes.narration: If the cache already has the profile, that is [[hit.answer]]a cache hit. [[hit.return]]The answer comes straight back, often in a fraction of a millisecond, and the database is never asked.

scenes.title: The slow path
scenes.narration: [[miss.ask-cache]]The app asks the cache, [[miss.not-found]]but it has nothing: a cache miss. [[miss.ask-database]]So it asks the database, [[miss.return-profile]]gets the profile, and [[miss.store-copy]]saves a copy for next time.

scenes.title: The trade-off
scenes.narration: There is one catch: [[stale.1]]a cached copy can go stale. If you change your name, [[stale.2]]the cache may still hold the old value for a little while.

scenes.title: Expire old answers
scenes.narration: To control staleness, [[ttl.1]]each cached item gets an expiry time, called a time to live. [[ttl.2]]When that time runs out, the cache drops the item, [[ttl.3]]and the next request fetches a fresh copy.

card.title: Cache entry
lines: Expired -> next request reloads it from the database

scenes.title: A controlled trade
scenes.narration: The result is [[outcome.left.1]]a faster site and fewer database reads, in exchange for [[outcome.right.1]]a small amount of staleness that you choose and control.
